== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|Judge Suriel{{!}}Suriel's [[Razor]] is a powerful, multi-functional weapon passed down through the lineage of the Sixth [[Judge]] of the [[Abidan Court]]. While it appears as a meter-long bar of blue [[steel]] when dormant, it can expand into an intricate [[skeleton]] of blue metal that resembles a branching tree arcing with light. Though it can be used for [[destruction]], its primary purpose is as a highly sophisticated instrument of healing and restoration. It functions as an incredibly complex scalpel capable of removing toxic energy, hostile intentions, or parasitic elements. When activated by the user's energy, it can perform massive feats of cosmic repair, such as mending the fabric of space, reassembling shattered planets, and even reversing the death of stars or individuals. The weapon is described as an obsolete prototype of absolute [[Authority|authority]], capable of severing attacks from existence and cutting through objects with ease.}}
